notes.title: Our first game goes free!
notes.notes:
Hello, DevDre here, lead developer of Carrion Wave.


Squeaky Clean released over a year ago as our first title. At the time it was just me and since then the team has slowly grown and we are hard at work on our next title.
I wanted to officially announce our departure from the horror genre for the foreseeable future, and while I do have an interest in creating scary scenes and situations, my true passion is in RPG's and story-telling.

This announcement comes from a worry that I don't think our upcoming title(s) will be of interest to horror fans, so I want to officially state that our first game is now archived, and [u]free for all to play[/u] as a piece of our history!

Thank you so much for those who played the game, and my support group and streamers for all their suggestions and feedback during development. It was a a great learning opportunity from development to release. I've worked on many games over my life, but I've never finished one, so regardless of its success (or lack there of) this was a milestone.

For now, we are working together with a growing Twitter artist to create a 2.5D colorful and fun RPG, and I'm confident it falls into my skillset far more-so than Squeaky Clean and I'm very excited for the future.

Expect a week or so before the price changes to free, but if anyone was on the fence on checking it out, then maybe now is a good time for a shower!

Thank you again,
DevDre
Carrion Wave

notes.title: Patch 05/05/21
notes.notes:
-Main menu theme made significantly quieter
-Proc-spook indicators are quieter
-A short spook-blocker has been implemented to prevent spook spam
-An occasional glitch that causes the spook indicator to play over and over again has been fixed
-Game can now be paused by pressing escape

notes.title: Credits fix
notes.notes: Credits were obscure and hidden before, fixed.

notes.title: Hotfix 3 : HUD fix
notes.notes: Very small update that fixes a HUD that carries over into the main menu upon exiting.

notes.title: Hotfix 2 : Red fade-in and camera shake fix
notes.notes:
-Fixed an issue where the shampoo would fade to red, rather than black.
-Removed the very fast camera shake effect that would on rare occasions get stuck off center.

notes.title: Hotfix : Xray layer fix
notes.notes: Fixes an oversight where a certain spook was not X-rayed and thus not visible to the player.

notes.title: Squeaky Clean is Live!
notes.notes:
[h1]Squeaky Clean is Live![/h1]

Carrion Wave's first game is now live and ready to play!
[i]It's time to make showers a spooky place to be![/i]

Thanks to everyone who tested the game pre-launch and to all of our supporters over the 7 month development cycle. This simple game turned out more complex than originally anticipated, but it was worth the frustrations!

If you have any questions or concerns please don't hesitate to ask at carrionwave@gmail.com!

[b]Thank you for checking out Squeaky Clean![/b]

notes.title: Game releases in 2 days!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello! [/b]
Squeaky Clean's release is just around the corner and work has continued daily to ensure it's polished and ready for you!
While the game's release date is set to April 30th it looks like the earliest we can see a release is on May 1st, so as soon as that clock hits 12:01am the game will be live!

Big thanks to my early testers for helping me nail down these issues, all the support is appreciated!

If you're here, thanks for checking in! I hope to spook ya' soon. 

-Carrion Wave
